summary: Tested Gmail OAuth endpoints and frontend recovery flow. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend renders /gmail correctly with connect UI; /gmail?gmail=error shows sonner error toast 'Could not connect Google account' and page remains fully usable — successfully navigated from error state to Bank Reconcile. Regression on /bank, dashboard OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1580 lines — consider splitting into routers (bank, gmail, pnl, auth) for maintainability.
gmail_callback logs no reason when fetch_token fails — swallowed exception hides diagnostic info; consider logger.exception() before redirect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Gmail OAuth endpoints verified: /api/oauth/gmail/login redirects to accounts.google.com with login_hint+prompt select_account+gmail.readonly scope; 401 for invalid token; /api/oauth/gmail/callback with error=access_denied or unknown state redirects to APP_BASE_URL/gmail?gmail=error (no 500). /api/gmail/status returns configured:true, connected:false; /api/gmail/sync returns 400 when not connected; /api/gmail/alerts returns []. Frontend: gmail-page & gmail-connect-btn present, sonner toast fires for ?gmail=error and nav remains usable. Regression pages /bank, dashboard, P&L, vendors all OK.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verified working per spec.
